acceptanceCriteria: Screen matching prefers the most specific route and uses a catch-all only when nothing else matches.
A focused test covers a specific route plus a catch-all.
body: Residual from lane sk-1022p (PR beamfall/corvint#1548, seal 6879bb81e). Catch-all routes (path *) match every URL with the same weight as specific routes, so screen joins are ambiguous or wrong.
title: AMAP ranks React Router catch-all screens no lower than specific routes
